confirmatory_rules.H1: SUPPORTED iff upper 95% CI of RMST_high_minus_low <= -0.50; FALSIFIED iff lower 95% CI >= 0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
confirmatory_rules.H2: SUPPORTED iff lower 95% CI of eta_high_minus_low >= 0.0005; FALSIFIED iff upper 95% CI <= 0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
confirmatory_rules.H3: SUPPORTED iff upper 95% CI of mean absolute macro drift after edit <= 0.05; FALSIFIED iff lower 95% CI > 0.05; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
confirmatory_rules.H4: SUPPORTED iff upper 95% CI of drift_delta_minus_full <= -0.02; FALSIFIED iff lower 95% CI >= 0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
confirmatory_rules.H5: SUPPORTED iff upper 95% CI of J_learned_minus_heuristic <= -5; FALSIFIED iff lower 95% CI >= 0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
confirmatory_rules.H6: SUPPORTED iff upper 95% CI of RMSE_history/RMSE_markov <= 0.90; FALSIFIED iff lower 95% CI >= 1.00; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE

stopping_rule: No outcome-dependent early stopping. Collection stops only at frozen sample target or documented external platform failure.
exclusions: post-hoc retried outputs not represented as a new transition
manual quality edits without a logged Flow action
